title: The screen's look is designed
body:
`src/ui.rs` is deliberately plain: prefixes, a dimmed thought, a tool line
with its status, a status bar in reverse video. Jack has strong views on how
a chat should look, and the dislike of Claude Code's own TUI is the reason
coax exists, so the design is his to direct. Nothing here is to be
redesigned on a session's own initiative; take direction and apply it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: foam's TUI (`../foam/src/tui.rs`) is Jack's chosen visual reference for this work. Its palette and its markdown renderer are moving into a shared crate (foam-000075 in foam's tracker).

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: Step d2 of the redesign landed: header, rounded session and prompt panes, footer hints, `src/palette.rs`. Next are d3 (prompt and thought styling, tool runs folded under "✦ N tools", which also fixes coax-efe3a6) and d4 (permission modal, plan side pane).

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: Steps d3 and d4 landed on dev: prompt and thought styling, tool runs under "✦ N tools", the permission box and the plan pane. The four-step redesign is complete; further changes come from Jack using it.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4d38e22a
notes.text: Landed on dev since the four-step redesign: the borderless layout (81c6809), the message thread (ee203c6), bordered boxes and the palette (be5017b, c0adfe2), panning (567afeb), the picker look (a8a85f2, f8a9596), header chips (4a2d95f), and the two-line Powerline header with drag, copy, expandable diffs and output (fb5026f, 8517a80, 1fd2c24). In progress: hover text on coloured chips uses the foreground colour, and clickable blocks get a fold marker.
